intro: Trying to find community college scholarships in the USA as an international student usually means sorting through mixed eligibility rules, study levels, and application steps. This filtered slice brings together a focused set of listings so you can compare options that may fit transfer plans, first-year community college enrollment, or broader college study. The rows below span themes such as education, STEM, community, medicine, arts, and more, so it is worth checking beyond your exact major. Awards vary by listing, deadlines differ across programs, and requirements are not uniform. When a provider application path is available, ScholarshipTop includes it so you can move from shortlist to submission more easily.
